missing_methods.intent: Verify product is displayed in cart
missing_methods.detailed_requirements: Wait for the cart items container to be visible, search for the product by product_name in the cart items list, verify that the product element is displayed and visible, and return True if found or raise an assertion error if not found.
implementation_checklist: Wait for 'cart_items_container' to be visible using wait_for(state='visible')
Locate the product heading element by role 'heading' with name matching product_name using page.get_by_role('heading', name=product_name)
Wait for the product heading element to be visible using wait_for(state='visible')
Verify the product heading element is visible using expect().to_be_visible()
Return True if all assertions pass

missing_methods.intent: Search for product and add to cart
missing_methods.detailed_requirements: Wait for search input field to be visible, enter the product_name, wait for search results to load, locate the product in results, click on the product or its 'Add to Cart' button, and wait for confirmation that the product has been added to cart.
implementation_checklist: Wait for 'search_input' to be visible using page.locator(self.locators['search_input']).wait_for(state='visible')
Clear any existing text in 'search_input' using page.locator(self.locators['search_input']).clear()
Enter product_name into 'search_input' using page.locator(self.locators['search_input']).fill(product_name)
Press Enter or click 'search_button' to trigger search using page.locator(self.locators['search_button']).click()
Wait for search results container 'search_results' to be visible using page.locator(self.locators['search_results']).wait_for(state='visible')
Locate the product in results using page.locator(self.locators['products'], has_text=product_name).first
Wait for the located product element to be visible using product.wait_for(state='visible')
Locate 'add_to_cart_button' within the product element using product.locator('button', has_text=' Add To Cart')
Verify 'add_to_cart_button' is visible using expect(add_cart_button).to_be_visible()
Click 'add_to_cart_button' using add_cart_button.click()

Wait for 'cart_confirmation_message' or 'cart_badge_count' to be visible to confirm product added using page.locator(self.locators['cart_confirmation_message']).wait_for(state='visible', timeout=5000) or verify cart count increased

missing_methods.detailed_requirements: Wait for the cart icon or cart button to be visible and clickable, click on it to navigate to the cart page, and wait for the cart page to load completely.
implementation_checklist: Wait for 'cart' to be visible using page.locator(self.locators['cart']).wait_for(state='visible')
Verify 'cart' is clickable using expect(page.locator(self.locators['cart'])).to_be_enabled()
Click 'cart' using page.locator(self.locators['cart']).click()
Wait for network idle state using page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
Wait for DOM content loaded state using page.wait_for_load_state('domcontentloaded')
Verify cart page loaded by waiting for 'cart_page_header' or 'cart_items_container' to be visible using page.locator(self.locators['cart_page_header']).wait_for(state='visible')
